verdict.rationale: Viam's docs describe 'logic modules' explicitly meant to react to sensor data (trigger alert/actuator on threshold), coordinate components, and schedule actions — a documented rules-based automation capability, plus cloud fleet 'alerting' features. However, this is implemented via custom code modules rather than a declarative no-code rule builder, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of ease-of-use or reliability for this specific feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the logic-module trigger system, and evidence of a simpler declarative rule-definition UI rather than requiring custom module code.
